characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia thread; a Keeper in the Order of Steering, husband of Seila, father of Zven and Lily. Thoughtful, earnest, a bit naive and philosophical; calm, curious, humble when wrong.

characters.name: Zven
characters.voice_notes: Gladias and Seila's young son; energetic, excitable, proud of his Helisport and physics; calls Gladias 'Dad'.

characters.name: Bai
characters.voice_notes: Minpentai player (second place in Pafogai Du), formerly Zei's rival, now ally. Confident, sharp, strategic, socially astute; orphaned and self-made; shows a gentler reflective side in ch24.

characters.name: Zei
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Dzego thread; national Minpentai champion and gifted cryptographer. Curious, quick, precise; explains technical things fluently and matter-of-factly; friendly host to Gladias. Occasionally speaks Dzegoban.

characters.name: Den
characters.voice_notes: High Council member of the Kungaupei (Dzego's shadow security organisation), Zei's mentor; sits in a shadowy cloak. Composed, controlled, authoritative, sparing with emotion; asks pointed questions.

notes: Z is shared: in the opening call scene (24:9-24:18, five runs) Z is Zven, Gladias's son, on a call (remote party); in the final scene with Den, Z is Zei (24:68, 24:89, 24:91 - listed as exceptions). The two never share a scene, so this is unambiguous. D is Den. 24:69 is Gladias speaking a Dzegoban greeting. 24:32 is narration quoting Gladias's reading of the sign, not speech. All attributions confident.
